conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I want to foreclose my loan, but the branch said I need some form. What’s that about?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I can help with that Sir. Can you share your loan account number?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s five six seven, eight nine zero, one two three four. I don’t know what forms they’re talking about.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: You need a foreclosure request form. I’ll email it to you with instructions.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Okay, but what’s foreclosure mean exactly? Nobody explained it.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It means paying off your loan early. The form confirms your request, and I’ll guide you through it.
